mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (user_id, target_type, target_id, content, encrypted_content, rating, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{content}, #{encryptedContent}, #{rating}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id as userId, u.nickname as nickname, r.target_type as targetType, r.target_id as targetId, r.content, r.rating, r.created_at as createdAt, r.updated_at as updatedAt FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.target_type = #{targetType} AND r.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
